data: 256 training questions with 2-5 exact calculator annotations and an integral final answer equal to the last annotated result. Exclude prior project evaluation items and direct pilot questions. protocol: Identical thinking-enabled chat for Base K1 and trained K3. One fixed worked demonstration. Request short equations, then Final answer: number. objective: Response-only full-vocabulary CE over calculator equations, closing thinking marker, final answer and official chat end. Fixed K3, same rank-eight block, fresh AdamW. Pin token boundary for entire prompt and response. Exclude overlength items before seeded sampling.
gate: Candidate must complete >=16/32 strict answers, gain at least 2 net correct answers over Base, and lose <=2 of 96 categorical third hops versus joint parent.
